title: eupatorium determinatum
intro: Eupatorium determinatum, commonly known as Boneset, is a perennial herb native to North America. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms associated with the flu and other respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Boneset include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughing. The bioactive constituents of Boneset include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
